scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n target,room,web -c yellow,cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace=@multicom/target" "npm run dev --workspace=@multicom/worker" "npm run dev --workspace=@multicom/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@multicom/web && npm run deploy:dry --workspace=@multicom/target && npm run deploy:dry --workspace=@multicom/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@multicom/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=@multicom/web-tools && npm run typecheck --workspace=@multicom/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace=@multicom/target && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:unit: npm run test --workspace=@multicom/web && npm run test --workspace=@multicom/web-tools && npm run test --workspace=@multicom/worker && npm run test --workspace=@multicom/target
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
